description:
Why Octopuses Have 3 Hearts? — Forget 1 red heart—this ocean genius hides 3 beating hearts and bright blue blood!
Kids science answer for "why octopuses have 3 hearts for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Two branchial hearts pump blood across the gills and one systemic heart pumps to the body using copper-rich blue blood suited for freezing deep oceans.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
